required.quote: Renewal of a license with active status requires compliance with requirements specified in rule.

available.quote: The board may issue a license to practice dentistry without further examination upon evidence that: (1) The applicant currently holds an active license in good standing to practice dentistry in another state

requirements.value: Applicant must hold an active license in good standing in another state with no disciplinary proceedings; have been in clinical practice at least 5 years for a minimum of 3,500 hours; graduated from a CODA-accredited dental school; completed national board dental examinations; completed a board-approved clinical examination; and paid the application fee.
requirements.quote: The board may issue a license to practice dentistry without further examination upon evidence that: (1) The applicant currently holds an active license in good standing to practice dentistry in another state with no disciplinary proceedings or unresolved complaints pending before the state's licensing board; (2) The applicant has been in clinical practice at least five (5) years immediately preceding the date of application for a minimum of three thousand five hundred (3,500) hours

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally misstating or failing to disclose material facts in a licensure application, cheating on an examination, or procuring a license by false or fraudulent means.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentionally misstate or fail fully to disclose a fact material to determination of fitness and qualification in an application for licensure to practice dentistry or cheat in an examination to practice dentistry; or procure a certificate or finding of qualification to practice dentistry or subsequently a license by false, fraudulent or deceitful means

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Make, or cause to be made, or assist in making, any fraudulent, false, or misleading statement as to his own or an employee's, associate's, or other dentist's, dental therapist's, or dental hygienist's skill or lack of skill, or method of practice

definition_quote.value: The practice of dentistry is the doing by one (1) person, for a direct or indirect consideration, of one or more of the following with respect to the teeth, gums, alveolar process, jaws, or adjacent tissues of another person, namely: Examining for diagnosis, treatment, extraction, repair, replacement, substitution, or correction; Diagnosing of disease, pain, injury, deficiency, deformity or physical condition; Treating, operating, prescribing, extracting, repairing, taking impressions, fitting, replacing, substituting, or correcting; Administering anesthetics or medicaments in connection with any of the foregoing.

specialist_license_available.quote: "Dental specialist" is a dentist who has graduated from a board-approved postgraduate program in the dentist's specialty and is a person both qualified and licensed by the laws of Idaho to practice a dental specialty recognized by the board.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" is supervision of a dental therapist, dental assistant, or dental hygienist requiring that a dentist diagnose the condition to be treated, that a dentist authorize the procedure to be performed, that a dentist remain in the practice setting while the procedure is performed, and that before dismissal of the patient a dentist approves the work performed by the dental therapist, dental assistant, or dental hygienist.

"Indirect supervision" is supervision of a dental therapist, dental assistant, or dental hygienist requiring that a dentist authorize a procedure and that a dentist be in the practice setting while the procedure is performed by the therapist, assistant, or hygienist.

"General supervision" is supervision of a dental therapist, dental assistant, or dental hygienist requiring that a dentist authorize the procedure which is carried out, but not requiring that a dentist be in the practice setting when the authorized procedure is performed.
